Loss-of-function mutations in the DMD gene disrupt the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, leading to impaired sarcomere organization, which manifests as muscle weakness in Duchenne muscular dystrophy and cardiomyopathy in dilated cardiomyopathy 3B.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in DMD exclusively associated with skeletal myopathy and not cardiac dysfunction, or vice versa, would falsify this shared mechanism. _(variant: rs799917717 (a known pathogenic variant in DMD, if found to be absent or at very low frequency in patients with DCM3B but present in those with DMD).)_
